name: Guided Optimization of NeRF
definition: Optimizes a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) by guiding the sampling of points along camera rays using adapted monocular depth priors, mitigating shape-radiance ambiguity in indoor scenes.
summary: Guided Optimization of NeRF mitigates shape-radiance ambiguity by restricting sampling ranges using monocular depth priors and geometric consistency errors, distinguishing itself by avoiding ground-truth depth labels during training.
